_comment: Shared defaults, committed to a PUBLIC repo — put nothing private here.
Real broker address and credentials go in appsettings.Local.json,
Games are loaded from your dashboard (not this file) after setup.
showOnlyInstalledGames hides games this PC does not have. Set it to
false only if a game you know is installed stops appearing.
allowBrowsing adds a Chrome tile for customers who want to surf.
It opens normally, in its own profile, wiped at the start of each session.
showInstalledGames adds games found on this PC to the menu, not just the
ones typed into the dashboard. showLaunchers adds Steam, Epic and Xbox.
